**The** 
**Impact** 
**You’ll Make**
 As a Senior Data Scientist on the Search team, you will shape how neighbors find the people, places, posts, and businesses that matter to them. You will own the data science behind query understanding, content retrieval, ranking, and the end\-to\-end search experience — partnering closely with ML, Engineering, PM, and Design to turn intent into outcomes.
   

  

 Search sits at the intersection of nearly every product surface at Nextdoor: it powers neighbor\-to\-neighbor discovery, connects neighbors to trusted local businesses (a core part of our marketplace and SMB strategy), and increasingly relies on LLM\-driven query understanding and semantic retrieval to handle the long, conversational queries our neighbors actually ask. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, technically strong data scientist to accelerate this work and help define what "great search" means at Nextdoor.
   

  

 This is an analyst \+ builder role. We are looking for someone who is equally comfortable digging into messy data to find the insight that reframes a problem and rolling up their sleeves to prototype, ship, and iterate on the solution alongside engineering. You should be energized by both halves of that loop — neither a pure analyst who hands off recommendations nor a pure modeler who skips the "why" — and willing to work end\-to\-end from question to production impact.
   

  

 Successful candidates will exhibit deep technical acumen, strong product sense, and business savvy, with a passion for shipping. You are excited to go deep on ranking and recommendation systems, semantic retrieval, and the application of LLMs to query understanding and evaluation.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Design and develop algorithms and models to optimize Search relevance, retrieval, and ranking — driving value for both neighbors and the businesses they discover
* Experiment design: ensure we run experiments efficiently and accurately, including monitoring early feature development through post\-release follow\-ups
* Develop and share key strategic insights through data analysis, including designing experiments and evaluating the performance and impact of data\-driven content and ranking changes
* Build scalable metrics and dashboards to track Search performance and inform decisions across query understanding, retrieval, ranking, and downstream engagement
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to support product development efforts (including product, design, engineering, marketing, and operations)
* Care deeply about data quality and empower employees to leverage data to help them succeed in their careers and help Nextdoor grow


**What You’ll Bring To The Team**
* 5\+ years of relevant Data Science experience
* Direct experience working on a Search, recommendations, or information retrieval product — familiarity with the core problems (query understanding, retrieval, ranking, relevance evaluation) and the metrics used to measure them
* Innate curiosity around finding meaningful insights that inform how we think about and develop our product and business strategies
* Working knowledge of ML models and — more importantly — the judgment to apply them to real business problems and to devise the right metrics for evaluating algorithms and ranking systems
* Strong working knowledge of experimentation, including designing and analyzing complex product A/B testing results, with fluency in handling interaction effects and long\-term metric movement
* Expert knowledge of SQL and Python, including common scientific computing packages and data science tools such as numpy, pandas, and scikit\-learn
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize, simplify, and explain complex problems to different types of audiences, including executives, and compile compelling narratives


**Bonus Points**
* Experience working with ranking algorithms for unstructured content
* Experience designing, deploying, or monitoring ML production models
* Basic understanding of how to build RAG systems

**Our Operating Principles**
***Extreme Ownership***
 We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame\-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.
   

  

***Craftsmanship***
 Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw\-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.
   

  

***We are “majos”***
 Be friendly \& have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine \& honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.
   

  

***Urgency with Focus***
 Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high\-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.
   

  

***Talent Density and Meritocracy***
 Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A\-players want to work with other A\-players — that’s how we win.
   

  

***First\-Principles Thinking***
 Strip a problem to physics\-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy\-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible
